chapter: Kirby again, Garland gigs and later recordings
title: Kirby band personnel and the changes before Milwaukee
summary: The first band had Brereton, Jerry Blake, Kirby, Kyle and Bishop; Pete Clark and Rostelle Reese replaced two for the Milwaukee run.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Who was the trumpet player. Do you know?
Yeah, it was Clarence Brereton. He's the one that couldn't stand up.
And let me see... We had a clarinet... He used to work with Doc Cheatham years ago. I was just thinking about him, too. The ....(?).... was just the clarinet, alto and the trumpet, plus...
Kirby on bass, Kyle on piano...
And Wallace Bishop on drums. Yeah, that was the band. It will come to me. I almost had it. Do you think I'm getting senile?
But anyway, you said Kirby was really very much for the men in the band. You said he'd do anything for his band.

Well, when he had a good band. Yeah, when he had a good band he would do anything. See, we come back to New York, and we change... We had a change in personnel. He put Pete Clark in the place of the clarinet player that he had. And Rostelle Reese, a trumpet player, he taken the place of Clarence Brereton. And we started out again, we went to Milwaukee -- and that was the personnel of the band in Milwaukee.
